title: Special Topics in Data Gathering and Analysis; Building Newsroom-Wide Tools with Artificial Intelligence
description:
Prerequisite: JOUR472 or permission of instructor.

This course will introduce students to how they can use AI coding assistants to automate newsroom processes and most importantly, make reporters' day-to-day lives easier! These skills can be applied to everyday newsr oom tasks such as sourcing data, maintaining complex databases, managing story tips, tracking coverage and analyzing content.
